test_conda_env_process: test that an MRP process defined with a Conda runtime receives the correct environment variables
define_mrp_process_with_conda_runtime: define an MRP process using mrp.Conda as the runtime with a custom run command and environment variables
start_mrp_process: start an MRP process by name using mrp.cmd.up with optional log reset
wait_for_mrp_process: wait for an MRP process to complete using mrp.cmd.wait
clear_defined_mrp_processes: clear all previously defined MRP processes using mrp.process_def.defined_processes.clear
